card.name: Words just before a predictable next word
card.fires_on: The word "healthcare" in "contact their healthcare provider", and the blank space after "to" or "and" in dose ranges. It also fires on a few other linking words where the next word is highly predictable.

modes.label: healthcare before provider
modes.description: The word healthcare in patient advice to notify or contact their healthcare provider.
modes.example: Instruct patients to contact their<< healthcare>> provider if signs or symptoms of an infection

modes.label: Space before a number in a range
modes.description: A space token after "to" or "and" in a dose range, right before the second number.
modes.example: Doses of ursodiol in the range of 16 to<< >>20 mg/kg/day have been tolerated

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Short words like "of", "contact" or "Do" where a fixed phrase continues.
modes.example: or to any component<< of>> the formulation.

card.plain: It fires on words in stock label phrases where the next word is nearly certain, such as "healthcare" before "provider".
